requirements.title: Scaled layout drawings of metal ductwork and fittings
requirements.requirement_text: Submit scaled layout drawings (3/8"=1') of metal ductwork and fittings including but not limited to duct sizes, locations, elevations, slopes of horizontal runs, wall and floor penetrations, and connections, including location of connections. Show modifications of indicated requirements, made to conform to local shop practice and how those modifications ensure that free area, materials and rigidity are not reduced. Layouts should include all the room plans, mechanical equipment rooms and penthouses.
